newsitem.title: UK: Boots to invest 7.6 mln stg in Irish stores.
newsitem.headline: Boots to invest 7.6 mln stg in Irish stores.

text.p: Boots Co Plc said on Tuesday it would invest 7.6 million stg to open up to five Boots The Chemists stores in Ireland.

The opening of all planned stores would create a total of 400 jobs. The first store will open in early November in Dublin's new Jervis shopping centre. This store represents an investment of 3.6 million stg and will lead to 150 jobs.
In the spring of 1997, stores will be opened in Tallaght and Dun Laoghaire at a cost of 0.75 million pounds and creating 60 jobs.
Boots is currently in talks for properties in Blanchardstown and the Quarryvale development. If these prove successful a further 190 jobs would be created with an investment of 3.25 million stg.
